# Junction Theme

<Agent>
Apply `junction` from the framework's matching theme package and pair it with `@farming-labs/theme/junction/css`. Verify the blueprint grid, dark navigation spine, electric-blue structural rails, numbered sections, paper-like article panel, and near-black code surfaces.
Junction is available for Next.js, TanStack Start, Farm.js, SvelteKit, Astro, and Nuxt. If the factory does not resolve, use the matching framework theme package. If the structure is absent but colors load, verify the shared `/junction/css` import.
</Agent>

Junction is a blueprint-inspired technical documentation preset influenced by engineering diagrams and the structured edge language used on [Jevia](https://jevia.dev). It combines a dark navigation spine, electric-blue rails, oversized editorial headings, numbered sections, and a pale grid canvas without copying another site's branding or content.

## Next.js, TanStack Start, and Farm.js

```tsx title="docs.config.ts"
import { defineDocs } from "@farming-labs/docs";
import { junction } from "@farming-labs/theme/junction";

export default defineDocs({
  entry: "docs",
  theme: junction(),
});
```

## SvelteKit

```ts title="src/lib/docs.config.ts"
import { defineDocs } from "@farming-labs/docs";
import { junction } from "@farming-labs/svelte-theme/junction";

export default defineDocs({
  entry: "docs",
  theme: junction(),
});
```

Astro uses `@farming-labs/astro-theme/junction`, and Nuxt uses `@farming-labs/nuxt-theme/junction`.

Import the shared visual layer for every framework:

```css title="global.css"
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@farming-labs/theme/junction/css";
```

## Defaults

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Primary | `#145cff` |
| Background | `#edf4ff` light, `#07111f` dark |
| Border radius | `0px` |
| Content width | 920px |
| Sidebar width | 264px |
| TOC width | 240px |
| Header height | 60px |

## Design Language

- A pale blueprint grid separates the content canvas from the near-black navigation spine.
- Electric-blue structural rails frame the header, sidebar, article, and TOC.
- Oversized page titles and numbered section markers make long technical pages easy to scan.
- Mono typography is reserved for navigation, controls, tables, and technical metadata.
- Code panels stay near-black in both color modes and use a cyan signal rail.
- Active navigation becomes a solid blue status bar with a cyan position marker.
- Reduced-motion preferences disable nonessential transitions and animation.

## Customizing

```tsx title="docs.config.ts"
theme: junction({
  ui: {
    colors: { primary: "#7c3aed" },
    layout: { contentWidth: 960, sidebarWidth: 280 },
  },
}),
```

Keep the accent saturated enough to remain visible against both the light canvas and the dark navigation surfaces.
